document_contents.quote: saying that the petitioner has, during this period, suppressed taxable value, and thereby made short payments of Central Goods and Service Tax.

defects_argued.quote: As could be seen, the Division Bench has, in categorical terms, held that there is no scope for consolidating various financial years/tax period while issuing show cause notice under Section 74 of the CGST Act.

outcome.quote: The order dated 26/9/2025 passed by respondent no.1, show cause notice dated 29/6/2025 issued by respondent no.4, and show cause notice dated 18/9/2025 issued by respondent no.3, are quashed and set aside.
